exercises.instructions: Choose the correct quantity expression (much, many, a lot of, a lot) for each sentence.

questions.question: There are ___ biscuits in the packet.
questions.explanation: 'a lot of' is used with countable nouns in affirmative sentences. 'biscuits' is plural countable. 'a lot of' ကို countable nouns နဲ့ affirmative sentences တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: 'much' is used with uncountable nouns in negative sentences. 'milk' is uncountable. 'much' ကို uncountable nouns နဲ့ negative sentences တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Have you got ___ tomatoes?
questions.explanation: 'many' is used with plural countable nouns in questions. 'tomatoes' is plural countable. 'many' ကို plural countable nouns နဲ့ questions တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: There is ___ rice.

questions.question: Today it rained ___.
questions.explanation: 'a lot' (without 'of') is used when there is no noun after it. 'a lot' ကို 'a lot' ရဲ့နောက်မှာ noun မရှိတဲ့အခါ သုံးပါ။

questions.explanation: 'many' is used with plural countable nouns. 'people' is plural countable. 'many' ကို plural countable nouns နဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: How ___ books are there? There are ___.
questions.explanation: 'many' is used with plural countable nouns like 'books'. 'a lot' (without 'of') is used when no noun follows. 'many' ကို plural countable nouns နဲ့ သုံးပါ။ noun မရှိရင် 'a lot' ကို သုံးပါ။
